scripts.db:psql: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml exec postgres psql -U ie -d indent_easy
scripts.db:smoke: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml exec -T postgres psql -U ie -d indent_easy -f /checks/constraint-smoke-test.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml rm -sf postgres && docker volume rm -f indent-easy_pgdata && docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml up -d postgres
